name: Spotify Album Wallpaper — Multi-Monitor Fork
author: emilsall (original), c8h10n4o2-b (multi-monitor fork)
description: Multi-monitor-focused fork of emilsall/omarchy-spotify-wallpaper with automatic, all-monitor, and named Hyprland output targeting.

barWidget.description: Multi-monitor fork with selectable output targeting, crop, and track info settings.

schema.label: Bar placement
schema.description: Choose which Omarchy bar section contains the plugin icon. Left preserves the original placement.

schema.label: Target monitor
schema.description: Choose auto to resolve the focused output on each wallpaper update, all for every connected monitor, or a named Hyprland output to pin album art there.

schema.label: Enabled
schema.description: When off, the album-art layer is removed and the normal Omarchy wallpaper is revealed.

schema.label: Crop mode
schema.description: Fullscreen fills the screen. Centered uses the artwork size slider. Native shows the original image size.

schema.label: Centered artwork size (%)
schema.description: Artwork size as a percentage of the shorter screen dimension in Centered mode.

schema.label: Show track info
schema.description: Display artist, album, and track title on the wallpaper using theme colors.

schema.label: Reset on close
schema.description: Remove the album-art layer when Spotify closes or playback stops.

schema.label: Blur effect
schema.description: Blur the album art in fullscreen mode, or use a blurred backdrop behind the art in centered modes.
